knownCurrentOverrideApplication: None: exporter records overrides but publish_mesh uses mesh defaults; World.ts has no per-object override application.

findings.summary: Current Web uses a selected area, not the complete original city.
findings.limit: Component totals are not all visible road segments; 211/1952 is component coverage, not area or visual-fidelity percentage.

findings.summary: 21 selected actors have 27 distinct override materials, recorded but not applied.
findings.limit: Original UE material slot numbers must not be equated with deduplicated glTF material indexes; original section-slot mapping is required.

findings.summary: The published white plaster has no base texture or normal map; original plaster also references normal and mildew maps, and some actor slots replace the default material.
findings.limit: Original Color default is white too. White is not by itself proof of a missing albedo; the proven losses are overrides, normal/mildew shading, and unverified lighting.

findings.summary: Every current glTF omits normal, metallicRoughness, occlusion and emissive texture slots.
RoadMain_A_Inst has original BaseColor/Compact/Height/Normal and wetness parameters; Web keeps only BaseColor.
findings.limit: Compact RGB packing and shader math are not established by texture names. Environmental defaults are not proof of runtime values.

findings.summary: Building glass, character lenses and car glass are separate shader families; current exporters replace each with arbitrary opaque constants.
findings.limit: No serialized translucent override was found for Sedan glass. Do not apply a global transparent-glass fix.

findings.summary: Body uses subsurface shading; clothing uses ID-region coloring and six texture channels; hair uses hue/value/opacity parameters. Current output reduces them to diffuse and tint.
findings.limit: Hair instance TextureParameterValues and CachedReferencedTextures disagree between Hair1 and Hair_001 families; final compiled binding needs additional verification.

findings.summary: UModel empty-parameters messages do not mean the original material has no parameters. UAssetAPI recovers the scalar/vector material parameters.
findings.limit: The inspected sedan material family has no imported Texture2D; missing texture is not the supported explanation for this asset.

findings.summary: Current fog, sky, sunlight and shadow constants were chosen by Web implementation; source Lighting map/post-process/reflection/lightmaps were not used.
findings.limit: Original lighting values are not recovered in this audit.
